audit.whatIsWrong: Labelled EVEN at 5.5/10 while the win rate is 20% and every content paragraph says Lillia cannot reach him at any point in the game.
audit.why: The lane is a ranged mage who outranges her by 400 units, self-peels with a knock-back, and denies the approach with a minefield. The content already concludes 'do not try to 1v1 the bomb'.
audit.corrected: diff moved to HARD, carry threat to 7/10, wording changed to a losing matchup. Sample is small (5 games), so I did not push the numbers further.

audit.whatIsWrong: The chart gave Lillia Levels 4-5, Level 6 and first item and called the rest even, while all seven whys describe a lane she never gets to touch.
audit.why: whys[3] 'Your best lane window is wasted — he never walks at you'; whys[4] his W knock-back denies the sleep; whys[5] 'his E minefield and Q range still deny you the approach'; whys[6] 'you can never reach him'. Packet levelChart is Ziggs on all seven rows.
audit.corrected: All seven rows set to Ziggs in both layers with matching ratings, as one group; phases[0].why, phases[3].why and phases[6].why rewritten so the reasons match the sides.

audit.whatIsWrong: No Ziggs ability is named in the full layer beyond Satchel Charge, no ranges are compared, and the mine damage falloff is nowhere.
audit.why: Bouncing Bomb is 850 range on 6/5.5/5/4.5/4 against Lillia's 450-range Q and 700-range E — she is outranged at every stage, which is the whole matchup. Satchel Charge is 20/18/16/14/12s at 1000 range and knocks both her and himself away, so it is escape and peel in one cast. Hexplosive Minefield is a flat 16s at 900 range and 'successive mine detonations on the same target deal reduced damage', so walking through a field costs less than standing in it. Mega Inferno Bomb is 120/95/70s at 5000 range.
audit.corrected: Range comparison, the dual knock-back on Satchel, the flat 16s minefield and the repeat-mine falloff now stated.

audit.why: The packet's suspectNames hit on 'Your Lilting Lullaby' in spikes[1] is a false positive — Lilting Lullaby is Lillia's real R name in her own kit file.
